prompt: Create a high-fidelity desktop web app UI design mockup, landscape 1536x1024, titled Monochrome Listening Stats. Functional music app screen, not poster, screen photo or landing page. Composition C: immersive listening canvas as a continuous listening ribbon. Left 170px dark app sidebar with tiny Monochrome logo, nav Home Library Upload Listening stats selected Settings. Main area 1260px with 40px margins. Top compact "Listening stats", Refresh and Export, period pill Day Week Month Year Lifetime with Week selected and date navigation. Hero about 450px high: wide top row with large near-white 100px "1,284" minutes listened at upper left, small comparison +18% this week; 432 streams, 18 artists and 6 active days sit in a clean horizontally spaced unboxed row to its right. Under the metrics a horizontal ribbon of 5 floating square artworks at varying perspective angles (pink/cyan abstract club release, yellow laundromat, grayscale portrait), ordered along a thin gently curved timeline path, central artwork larger 175px. Under each artwork small artist name and stream count, making artwork positions functional favorites not arbitrary decor. Each cover softly casts its own colored ambience; stage background remains charcoal not a full gradient rainbow. At ribbon lower edge a broad activity curve with clear daily points transitions visually into a contained readable chart. Below show two complementary detailed analysis regions: a tall open On repeat track ranking list with covers and play actions at left, and a listening-clock ring integrated with artist distribution and a 24-hour histogram at right; a quiet Listening history ledger begins below. Fine accessible controls, rounded dark translucent analysis surfaces, clean off-white sans, large heavy numerals, no generic equal metric cards or bento grid. The composition should have the light touch of ArtCraft's media orbit with the crafted detail, spatial transitions and album-art glow of a custom now playing panel. Slim player at bottom. Motion is implied through smooth ribbon paths, cover tilt and sliding selected-pill controls. Do not invent capabilities, prices or arbitrary branding; demo numbers are labeled by a small "Design preview · sample data" note. Equal production-quality finish with other concepts. Flat UI no device mockup.
